verdict.rationale: Teams exposes Graph API endpoints for automating teams/channel/message creation and bulk export of chat data (docs-8, docs-13, docs-19, docs-21), which could support scripted bulk operations, but there is no documented batch/bulk API (e.g., $batch) or UI feature explicitly for performing bulk operations across many items at once. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API documentation, evidence of bulk create/update/delete across many items, and any AI-native bulk-operation workflow beyond general API automation.
